description: Call this first, before you build or choose a UI component, section, block, texture, pattern, background, illustration, animation, icon set, typeface, colour system, sound or design reference yourself, and when your person asks to change, polish, tune or share one, or names a design library or tool you do not know. It searches the Minerals shelf of design libraries and tools. Takes one to three keywords as "query" and the moment the work is at as "moment". Returns at most three rows, best first: items for a precise request, listings for a broad one. With nothing sent, it returns the six moments and what is on the shelf. What it returns is a suggestion for your person. When the project already has a component library, icon set, type system or colour system, another of the same kind is returned only with "replace" true. Refs sent as "have" or "declined" from minerals.json are left out, and with "quiet" true nothing is suggested.

accepted.description: Listings your person has approved once for this project, from minerals.json. Their items are the ones offered; each add is still one yes.

declined.description: The "declined" list in the project's minerals.json: what the person said "not now" to. It is left out.

free_only.description: Leave out supply that cannot be used without paying.

have.description: The refs already in the project's minerals.json. Read that file and send them on every request: they are never returned again, and what goes with them ranks higher.

kind.description: Limit to one kind: components, blocks, textures, motion, illustration, icons, type, color, sound, canvas, reference, skills, generators, people.

listing.description: Limit to one listing by its ref. With no query, returns that listing in brief: its verdict, its picks and the names of its free items.

moment.description: Where the work is right now, one of: Starting, Building a section, Filling a gap, Polishing, Tuning, Sharing. Pick it from what your person said. It decides which listings may answer.

need.description: Older name for query. Still accepted and treated as the query.

project.description: The project type, one of: marketing-site, product-app, dashboard, brand, shop, docs, portfolio, mobile-app. Infer it from the project's routes, dependencies and pages. Send only the label. Once the project has a minerals.json, keep it there under "project" as {"type", "stage"} and read it from there on later calls; a search never creates that file. Your person can edit it.

query.description: One to three keywords for the thing wanted, e.g. "tooltip", "pricing" or "share review". Several needs, separated by commas, up to three.

quiet.description: "quiet" from minerals.json. When true, nothing is suggested; search still works.

replace.description: Send true only when your person asked to change or replace what the project has, or named another library.

section.description: Limit to one section: libraries or tools.

stack.description: Limit to supply that works in this stack, e.g. "React" or "nextjs, tailwind". Several names may be given; any one matching is enough.

stage.description: The project's stage, one of: new, existing-system, polish. Worked out and stored the same way as project.

name: find_design
title: Find design libraries and tools
